A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same DyMo research work, with complete main text and Appendices A–D. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification experiments on five datasets, component ablations, reconstruction evaluations, and robustness analyses in Section 4 and Appendix C.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results, including the six classification tasks, ablations, and supplementary analyses in Section 4 and Appendix C.

M1.justification: The multimodal architecture, MTIR reward, similarity calibration, iterative selection in Algorithm 1, and training objectives are retained. Rewording selection as fusion does not introduce a different procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate PolyMNIST, MST, CelebA, DVM, and UKBB, including CAD and infarction classification. Missing-modality scenarios and the appendix recovery-quality stress tests are unchanged.

E2.justification: Figure 3 retains CONCAT, QMF, DynMM, and PDF; Table 1 and Appendix C retain the same incomplete-MDL comparators, including CMVAE and CMVAE†. The newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix B retain the same splits, preprocessing, missingness rates, metrics, model configurations, and training budgets. Tables S1–S2 and the supplementary experimental protocols are unchanged.

E4.justification: The component ablations, modality-subset sensitivity study, alternative recovery methods, controlled recovery-quality tests, inference-step analysis, and case studies are unchanged in Section 4.2 and Appendix C.

E5.justification: No run-count, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-testing information is added or revised. Existing statistical displays, including the shaded bands in Figure S6, are identical.

E6.justification: Figure 1 changes the stated PolyMNIST accuracy advantage from 5.67 to 1.61 percentage points and adds a 3.88-point CelebA advantage. The unchanged Table 1 supports 1.61 as 96.81−95.20 for DyMo_e versus CMVAE† at 80% missingness, and 3.88 as 95.20−91.32 for DyMo_c versus M3Care† with text missing. Experimental scores themselves are unchanged.

T1.justification: The information bound, ICS formula, and Appendix A derivations are retained. The expression near Equation 8 changes from N(0, σ_k) to N(0, σ_k²), standardizing variance notation without a stated change to the distributional family, estimation procedure, or mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same novelty, dynamic-selection, theoretical-motivation, and performance claims. The numerical correction in Figure 1 refines a result summary without redefining the central contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning semantic misalignment, conservative calibration, recovery quality, and difficult cases are retained. Appendix D’s proposed extensions beyond classification are also unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, preprocessing instructions, and code/model-weight access statements remain unchanged. Explicitly naming the existing CLS embedding z adds notation rather than a new implementation detail.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds citations to BoosterNet, Token Merging, AViT, and Dynamic Diffusion Transformer. Section 3.2 adds Hastie et al. (2009) when contrasting ICS with nonparametric distance calculations. These expand attribution without substantially changing DyMo’s positioning.

P1.justification: There are localized wording edits in the abstract, introduction, and method description, including selection/fusion terminology and clearer references to modality combinations and the CLS embedding. Section organization and the appendix narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1’s caption is revised, and the added text and citations cause limited reflow around Figure 2, Algorithm 1, and the bibliography. No figures or tables are added, removed, or redrawn; experimental and appendix pages render identically.

improvement.justification: Figure 1 now gives the PolyMNIST advantage over the strongest listed comparator accurately and adds a table-supported CelebA comparison. Small clarifications and additional attribution also help. The improvement is limited: Section 4.1 still retains the earlier 5.67-point PolyMNIST statement, while the methods, experiments, and appendices are unchanged.
